project_info.title: Rapid fashion transformation through time and space

prompt.main_subject: An energetic adult fashion influencer with a confident smile and strong camera presence, modeling varied brand clothing through continuous spinning transitions.
prompt.composition_elements: A candy-toned TikTok/Reels montage moves from a minimalist studio to a sunny street cafe, graffiti wall, seaside sunset, and high-altitude terrace night view. Each spin match-cuts to a new location and outfit.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: High-saturation candy tones and rhythmic fast cuts create dazzling visual pleasure. Preserve the distinct atmosphere of each listed location without inventing additional styling.

technical_specs.duration_pacing: Use the source's 0:00-0:15 storyboard pacing as narrative timing; do not treat it as an API duration parameter.
technical_specs.camera: Medium follow shot, then medium close-up with slow motion up-shift for the final freeze frame.
technical_specs.editing: Rapid montage match cuts triggered by the model's spin.
technical_specs.motion: Continuous spins connect locations and outfits.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: TikTok/Reels viral short-video style with high-saturation candy tones and rhythmic fast cuts. Emphasize montage techniques, using an adult fashion influencer's continuous movements to connect different time and space while showcasing varied brand clothing. The influencer has an energetic presence, confident smile, and strong camera sense. At 0:00-0:03, use a medium follow shot in a minimalist studio: she wears comfortable home leisure wear, playfully smiles at the camera, then begins a large dynamic spin in place. At 0:03-0:12, use rapid montage match cuts: every time she spins to face the camera, she seamlessly changes location and outfit, first turning to a sunny street cafe in a stylish workplace suit, then to a graffiti wall in cool street fashion, then to a seaside sunset in a flowing vacation long dress. At 0:12-0:15, use a medium close-up with a slow motion up-shift on a city high-altitude terrace at night: she completes the last spin in a gorgeous evening gown, freezes confidently against brilliant city lights, and the brand text JOHN fades in. Preserve the candy-tone commercial fashion energy and clear spin transitions.
prompt.negative_prompt: blurry, low resolution, noise, watermark, unintended text, unintended logo, distortion, deformation, disfigured face, identity drift, stiff movements, frame drops, camera shake, flicker, disproportionate, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed
